description: This file defines API utility functions for making POST requests and building URLs within the web frontend. It exports functions for sending JSON POST requests to the backend and for constructing full API URLs based on the current base URL.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the specified backend path and returns the parsed JSON response or throws an error if the request fails.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URL for a given API path using the current base URL.
